verified_existing.evidence: 10-K FY24 p.2272: 'Net sales $20,045,329' (en milliers, soit 20.045 Mds USD pour fiscal 2024). Stored 20.96 surévalué de ~4.5%.
AR FY24 p.20: 'comparable club sales growth of 2.8% in fiscal 2024 (excluding gas sales)'. Stored 1.0% est très en-dessous de la vraie valeur communiquée.
10-K FY24 ligne 465: 'Our membership fee income was $456.5 million for fiscal year 2024'. Stored 499.8 surévalué de ~9.5%.
10-K FY24: 'Cost of sales was 83.5% of net sales' => Gross margin = 16.5%. Stored 16.7% acceptable (delta < 1.5%).
10-K FY24 p.2402: 'SG&A increased by 5.0% to $3.0 billion in fiscal year 2024'. Détail p.2276: $2,963,883 milliers. Stored 3.15 surévalué de ~6%.

new_kpis.evidence: AR FY24 p.14: '90% renewal rate for the third consecutive year' — métrique différenciante du modèle club warehouse.
AR FY24 p.13: 'surpassed 7.5 million members'. Driver direct du membership fee income.
AR FY24 p.16: 'higher-tier members comprised 39% of our membership base, an increase of 14 percentage points since fiscal 2018'.
AR FY24 p.26: 'Our own brands comprised approximately 26% of our merchandise sales in fiscal 2024' — driver de gross margin.
AR FY24 p.52: 'opened seven new clubs and 12 gas stations, including our 250th club, marking our entry into Kentucky, our 21st state'.

notes: BJ: 4 KPIs sur 5 nécessitent correction (Net Sales -4.5%, Comp Club Sales largement faux, Membership Fee -9.5%, SG&A -6%). 5 NEW KPIs PV>=8 extraits du 10-K/AR FY24 (renewal rate, members, tier mix, own brands, clubs).
